entry.name: Chesnaught-S
entry.flavor: When its allies are in trouble, Chesnaught creates a shield with its arms and uses its own body to block attacks.
entry.flavorEs: Cuando adopta una postura defensiva juntando ambos puños delante de la cara, es capaz de resistir incluso el impacto directo de una bomba.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Planta infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其草属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Planta infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.
abilities.textEs: No le afectan las bombas ni algunos proyectiles.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.
abilities.detailEs: Protege contra movimientos basados en balas, bolas y bombas.
abilities.detailZh: 可以防住弹丸类、球类和炸弹类招式。
abilities.detailPt: Protege contra movimentos baseados em projéteis, bolas e bombas.
